name: create_project
description: Creates a new Supabase project, which can add to the organization's bill. The user must agree to any nonzero quoted cost before the project is created. Unless `confirm_cost_id` is required, call this tool without it and without asking for cost confirmation in chat first. The server handles cost confirmation, or returns instructions for obtaining a confirmation ID. If it requests an ID, follow those instructions and retry with it. A project quoted at $0 may be created without a cost-confirmation form. Always ask the user which organization to create the project in. The project can take a few minutes to initialize - use `get_project` to check the status.

confirm_cost_id.description: The ID returned by `confirm_cost`. To get it, call `get_cost`, tell the user the cost, and call `confirm_cost` once they agree.

region.description: The region to create the project in.
